content.query:
select CLTCODE CLTCODE2,SCD_START_DATE SCD_START_DATE_2, SCD_END_DATE SCD_END_DATE_2,* from (
SELECT CLTCODE CLTCODE2, * FROM
EDS.SEC_TBLCLIENT WHERE CLTCODE='3537'
UNION ALL
SELECT CLTCODE CLTCODE2, * FROM
EDS.SEC_TBLCLIENT WHERE CLTCODE='3597'
UNION ALL
SELECT CLTCODE CLTCODE2, * FROM
EDS.SEC_TBLCLIENT WHERE CLTCODE='57'
UNION ALL
SELECT CLTCODE CLTCODE2, * FROM
EDS.SEC_TBLCLIENT WHERE CLTCODE='999999' ) temp order by CLTCODE, SCD_START_DATE
